blocks.text: Jab tennis ki do gendein takrati hain to takrao ke baad woh pehle se kam velocity se wapas uchhalti hain. Is dauran kinetic energy (K.E., harkat ki energy) ka kuch hissa zaya (lost) ho jata hai: kuch ragar (friction) se, jab gendein dabti hain aur un ke molecules ek doosre par phisalte hain, aur kuch hissa garmi (heat) aur awaz (sound) ki energy ban jata hai.
Jis takrao (collision) mein system ki K.E. barqarar (conserved) na rahe, use inelastic collision kehte hain.
Kuch khaas halaat mein takrao mein koi kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti.
Mithali (ideal) soorat mein jab koi K.E. zaya na ho, takrao perfectly elastic kehlata hai.

Misal: sakht gend marble ke farsh par giraayi jaye to taqreeban usi unchai tak wapas uchhalti hai; farsh se takrao mein bohat hi kam energy khoti hai. Yaad rahe: momentum aur kul (total) energy har qism ke takrao mein conserved rehte hain, lekin K.E. sirf elastic takrao mein conserved rehti hai.
Ek dimension mein elastic takrao

Do chikni (smooth), na ghoomne wali gendein lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain aur jo shuru mein ek hi simt mein v₁ aur v₂ velocities se chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain aur takrao ke baad baghair ghoome usi seedhi lakeer mein chalti hain. Takrao ke baad un ki velocities v₁′ aur v₂′ hain (Fig. 2.10).

blocks.alt: Takrao se pehle: gendein m1 aur m2 velocities v1 aur v2 se daen taraf. Takrao ke baad: wahi gendein velocities v'1 aur v'2 se daen taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.10: Ek dimension mein elastic takrao, pehle aur baad (kitab ki Figure 2.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Daen (right) taraf ko velocity aur momentum ki positive simt lein. Momentum ke conservation se:
Takrao elastic hai, is liye K.E. bhi conserved hai:
a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b) laga kar:

blocks.text_alt: or m₁(v₁ + v₁′)(v₁ - v₁′) = m₂(v₂′ + v₂)(v₂′ - v₂)   (2.30)

blocks.text: Ab Eq. (2.30) ko Eq. (2.29) se taqseem karein; m₁(v₁ - v₁′) aur m₂(v₂′ - v₂) dono taraf kat jate hain:

Takrao se pehle (v₁ - v₂) pehli gend ki doosri gend ke hisaab se (relative) velocity hai, aur takrao ke baad (v₁′ - v₂′). In ki miqdar barabar hai lekin simt ulat jati hai. Yani: qareeb aane ki relative velocity (velocity of approach) ki miqdar door jane ki relative velocity (velocity of separation) ke barabar hoti hai.
Equations (2.29) aur (2.30) mein m₁, m₂, v₁ aur v₂ maloom hain. Inhen hal kar ke na-maloom v₁′ aur v₂′ nikalte hain:
Ab kuch khaas (special) soortein dekhte hain:
(i) Jab m₁ = m₂
Eq. (2.32) aur (2.33) mein m₁ = m₂ rakhne se:

blocks.latex: v_1' = v_2 \quad\text{and}\quad v_2' = v_1 \qquad (\text{as shown in Fig. 2.11})
blocks.text_alt: v₁′ = v₂ and v₂′ = v₁   (as shown in Fig. 2.11)

blocks.alt: case (i). Takrao se pehle: barabar gendein m1 aur m2 velocities v1 aur v2 se daen taraf. Takrao ke baad: m1 v'1 = v2 se aur m2 v'2 = v1 se chalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.11: Soorat (i), m1 = m2 (kitab ki Figure 2.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani barabar mass wali gendein takrao mein apni velocities aapas mein badal leti hain.
(ii) Jab m₁ = m₂ aur v₂ = 0
Is soorat mein m₂ ruki hui hai (v₂ = 0). Eqs. (2.32) aur (2.33) se:

Matlab m₁ takrao ke baad ruk jati hai aur m₂ usi velocity se chal parti hai jo pehle m₁ ki thi (Fig. 2.12). Isi liye mez par chalti billiard ball jab bilkul waisi ruki hui ball se takrati hai to pehli ruk jati hai aur doosri usi velocity se chal parti hai.

blocks.alt: case (ii). Takrao se pehle: m1 v1 se m2 ki taraf chalti hai jo sukoon mein hai (v2 = 0). Takrao ke baad: m1 ruk jati hai (v'1 = 0) aur m2 v'2 = v1 se chalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.12: Soorat (ii), m1 = m2 aur v2 = 0 (kitab ki Figure 2.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: (iii) Jab halka jism ruke hue bhaari jism se takraye
Yahan v₂ = 0 aur m₂ >> m₁ (m₂, m₁ se bohat bara). m₂ ke muqable m₁ ko chhor sakte hain. Eq. (2.33) aur (2.32) se v₁′ = -v₁ aur v₂′ = 0.
Yani m₁ usi speed se wapas uchhalti hai aur m₂ apni jagah ruki rehti hai (Fig. 2.13). Squash player isi baat se faida uthata hai: gend deewar se usi speed se wapas aati hai.

blocks.alt: case (iii). Takrao se pehle: chhoti gend m1 v1 se bohat bari gend m2 ki taraf chalti hai jo sukoon mein hai. Takrao ke baad: m1 v'1 = -v1 se wapas aati hai aur m2 sukoon mein rehti hai (v'2 = 0).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.13: Soorat (iii), halka jism sukoon mein bhari jism se takrata hai (kitab ki Figure 2.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: (iv) Jab bhaari jism ruke hue halke jism se takraye

Yahan m₁ >> m₂ aur v₂ = 0, is liye Eqs. (2.32) aur (2.33) mein m₂ ko chhor sakte hain. Is se v₁′ ≈ v₁ aur v₂′ ≈ 2v₁. Yani bhaari jism ki velocity taqreeban nahi badalti, lekin halka jism aage ki taraf takrane wale jism ki taqreeban dugni velocity se uchhal jata hai (Fig. 2.14).

blocks.alt: case (iv). Takrao se pehle: bari gend m1 v1 se chhoti gend m2 ki taraf chalti hai jo sukoon mein hai. Takrao ke baad: m1 taqreeban v1 se chalti rehti hai aur m2 taqreeban 2v1 se aage nikal jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.14: Soorat (iv), bhari jism sukoon mein halke jism se takrata hai (kitab ki Figure 2.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 2.8
blocks.problem: 70 g ki gend 140 g ki doosri gend se takrati hai. Pehli gend ki initial velocity 9 m s⁻¹ daen taraf hai aur doosri ruki hui hai. Agar takrao perfectly elastic ho to takrao ke baad dono gendon ki velocity kya hogi?
steps: Diya gaya: m₁ = 70 g, v₁ = 9 m s⁻¹, m₂ = 140 g, v₂ = 0; maloom karna hai v₁′ aur v₂′.
v₂ = 0 hai, is liye (2.32) ka doosra hissa zero: v₁′ = ((m₁ - m₂)/(m₁ + m₂)) v₁ = ((70 - 140)/(70 + 140)) × 9 m s⁻¹ = (-70/210) × 9 m s⁻¹ = -3 m s⁻¹
Isi tarah (2.33) se: v₂′ = (2m₁/(m₁ + m₂)) v₁ = (140/210) × 9 m s⁻¹ = 6 m s⁻¹
blocks.answer: v₁′ = -3 m s⁻¹ (negative: pehli gend wapas baen taraf jati hai) aur v₂′ = 6 m s⁻¹ daen taraf.

blocks.prompt: Elastic aur inelastic takrao mein farq batayein. Squash ki gend deewar se taqreeban usi speed se wapas kyun aati hai jis se takrati hai?
blocks.explanation: Elastic takrao mein momentum aur kinetic energy dono conserved rehte hain; inelastic mein momentum conserved rehta hai lekin kuch kinetic energy garmi, awaz ya shakal bigarne mein chali jati hai. Kul energy aur momentum dono qism mein conserved hain. Gend halki hai aur deewar bhaari aur ruki hui, to soorat (iii) ke mutabiq v₁′ = -v₁ aur v₂′ = 0: gend usi speed se wapas aati hai aur deewar apni jagah rehti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Inelastic: K.E. conserved nahi; perfectly elastic: koi K.E. zaya nahi. Momentum aur kul energy har takrao mein conserved.

Seedha elastic takrao: m₁(v₁ - v₁′) = m₂(v₂′ - v₂); v₁ + v₁′ = v₂′ + v₂ (qareeb aane ki relative speed = door jane ki relative speed); v₁′ aur v₂′ ke formulas (2.32), (2.33); chaar khaas soortein. Example 2.8: -3 m s⁻¹ aur 6 m s⁻¹.
